items.title: Bespoke OLAP: Using AI to Synthesize Workload-Specific DBMS Engines from Scratch
items.raw_excerpt: Every modern OLAP engine pays a hidden performance tax: the cost of being general-purpose. What if we could let AI build a database engine for exactly your workload, from scratch, in a few hours? We introduce Bespoke OLAP, a fully autonomous synthesis pipeline that uses LLM-guided code generation to produce complete, workload-specific C++ database engines, achieving 11.78x total speedup over DuckDB on TPC-H.

items.title: 扣子宣布2.5版本升级，探索AI Agent从“工具”到“伙伴”的关键一步
items.raw_excerpt: 4月7日，扣子宣布2.5版本升级，正式推出AI Agent协作平台Agent World，为AI Agent提供了包含人格、技能、装备三项支撑的“满配”运行基座，新增独立邮箱身份、云手机、云电脑等功能模块，并升级了视频创作Agent等能力。   年初OpenClaw的爆火，成为AI Agent从概念走向全民落地的催化剂。扣子此次升级2.5版本，定位于用户的“满配 AI 伙伴”，旨在探索AI Agent从“工具”到“伙伴”的关键一步。 扣子2.5为AI Agent提供的运行基座包含人格、装备、技能三项支撑，有效拓展了文本对话框和API调用的边界。 “人格”层面，扣子2.5提供了独立邮箱身份和记忆系统。AI Agent可通过独立的邮箱身份实现自主通信交流，和人类用户账号的资源权限互相隔离，更安全便捷。同时，AI Agent可通过长期记忆深刻理解用户的工作习惯与细微偏好。值得注意的是，用户与扣子在飞书、微信、网页等各个渠道的对话相互独立，但各渠道保存的记忆共享，同时严格按Session隔离权限，私聊信息不会泄露到群聊。   “装备”层面，扣子2.5为AI Agent打造了专属工作台。用户在对话中说明任务即可让Agent自动创建日程，还能通过“日历”功能了解Agent工作节奏、创建定时任务、协调Agent状态。此外，用户任务运行中产出的所有数据、图表和业务报告，都会自动分类保存到“文件系统”之中。 扣子2.5中的AI Agent还拥有自己的云电脑和云手机。基于云电脑设备，AI Agent可以在真实的桌面系统中运行代码脚本，像人类一样浏览网页、处理文件，拥有桌面级生产力。而云手机设备预装了Android 13系统，AI Agent可以下载APP，也能直接滑动页面并进行点击操作，其中重要操作仍由人类用户接管。云电脑和云手机均可在后台自动执行任务，直接为用户返回结果。

This platform provides a fully-equipped operational base for AI Agents, including personality, skills, and equipment, along with new features such as independent email identities, cloud phones, and cloud computers. It also enhances capabilities like video creation Agents.

The early-year explosion of OpenClaw catalyzed the transition of AI Agents from concept to widespread adoption. Kousi's 2.5 upgrade positions itself as a "fully-equipped AI companion" for users, aiming to take a crucial step in transforming AI Agents from tools to partners.

Kousi 2.5's operational base for AI Agents includes three key supports: personality, equipment, and skills, effectively expanding the boundaries of text dialogues and API calls. On the "personality" front, Kousi 2.5 offers independent email identities and memory systems. AI Agents can communicate independently through their own email addresses, with resource permissions isolated from human user accounts, ensuring greater security and convenience. They can also deeply understand users' work habits and subtle preferences through long-term memory. excerpt_i18n.es: El 7 de abril, Kòuzi anunció la actualización a la versión 2.5, lanzando oficialmente la plataforma de colaboración de Agentes AI, Agent World, que proporciona a los Agentes AI un soporte completo con personalidad, habilidades y equipo.
